nodes.name: Base layout shell
nodes.role: The HTML shell every page uses: head/SEO/meta tags, theme boot script, hardcoded site navigation with JS-measured collapse, footer, and ~390 lines of inline styles.
nodes.community_check: disagree: graphify community 73 ('Astro Base Layout') lumps Base.astro together with 404.astro and credits.astro; those are just its thinnest consumers, while the layout itself is a distinct shared shell with fan_in 18.

proposed_changes.target: one shared nav component instead of two independent hamburger-nav implementations
proposed_changes.rationale: Base.astro bundles head+nav+footer+styles in one hotspot file, and the site ships two independently-maintained mobile nav implementations.

nodes.name: Homepage hero
nodes.role: The landing page: wordmark, glitch animations, and a scatter of highlighted claim cards whose positions are computed by build-time random geometry. Carries its own burger nav separate from Base's.
nodes.community_check: disagree: graphify community 78 ('Verdict Sorting Utilities') is built from generic for()/if() nodes and does not isolate the homepage as a unit; the page is really three units (scatter geometry, glitch script, page markup) fused into one file.

proposed_changes.target: server-rendered content + a small islands-based interactive layer instead of one file mixing geometry, glitch effects, and markup
proposed_changes.rationale: The homepage fuses random scatter geometry, a glitch engine, and page markup in one 1k-line file with non-reproducible builds.

nodes.name: Research hub and FAQ
nodes.role: The /research landing page: section index, methodology explainer, and FAQ rendered twice (visible details elements plus a hand-maintained FAQPage JSON-LD copy).
nodes.community_check: disagree: no listed community isolates this page; graphify attaches it to the Base layout cluster, hiding that its FAQ content is a dual-maintained data set, not layout.

proposed_changes.target: single FAQ source rendered in both the visible section and the JSON-LD block
proposed_changes.rationale: The FAQ exists twice on /research and the JSON-LD copy has already drifted into overstating human review.

nodes.name: Research collection indexes
nodes.role: List pages for each research collection. Companies/products/subjects are near-identical copies; claims/sources/criteria share the FilterBar client-side filtering pattern.
nodes.community_check: disagree: none of the listed communities group these seven siblings; graphify splits them by shared symbol names (getStaticPaths, entries) rather than by the route family they obviously form.

nodes.name: Research detail routes
nodes.role: getStaticPaths-driven detail pages: claim verdict pages with audit trail and ClaimReview JSON-LD, entity profiles with criteria matrices, source pages with reverse citations, criteria coverage matrices, per-topic rollups.
nodes.community_check: agree: community 57 ('Astro UI Components') groups the getStaticPaths detail routes together, matching this unit, though it also pulls in resources/[...slug] from a different route family.

nodes.name: Resources hub and layouts
nodes.role: The consumer-facing resources section: a hub page plus a single dynamic route that switches between four layout modes (guide, article, matrix, tool) validated per-layout with Zod.
nodes.community_check: agree: community 106 ('Resources Page Components') matches this unit almost exactly (ResourcePage.astro, FURTHER_READING, entries, index.astro).

nodes.name: Static one-off pages
nodes.role: Hand-written standalone pages: the 404 fallback, the uncited values manifesto, and asset credits. Thin Base consumers with local styles.
nodes.community_check: agree: community 73 groups 404.astro and credits.astro with Base.astro, which is accurate for these thin consumers even though it mislabels the cluster as layout.

nodes.name: Shared fixtures and conftest
nodes.role: Session-wide pytest fixtures: run-id reset, CLI log isolation, repo-root resolution, plus a handful of HTML/markdown sample files. Only 57 lines; almost all reusable helpers live copy-pasted in individual test files instead.
nodes.community_check: disagree: no graphify community corresponds to a shared-fixture layer; the graph groups tests by production topic, which reflects the reality that this layer is too thin to register

nodes.name: Orchestrator and persistence suites
nodes.role: Tests verify_claim/onboard_entity/research_claim orchestration, threshold gating, blocked-reason classification, and the audit-sidecar writer. Heaviest churn and LOC in the suite; relies on monkeypatching pipeline internals (_research, _ingest_urls, _analyse_claim) and globally neutralizing Agent.override.
nodes.community_check: disagree: graphify splits this into fine per-feature communities (e.g. 23 'Verify Config Blocklist', parts of 12/17) and does not see the audit-trail + onboard + orchestrator files as one unit, but they share the same fake-research/fake-ingest scaffolding and break together

proposed_changes.target: assertions that fail loudly on error instead of being skipped by if-guards
proposed_changes.rationale: Several tests only assert inside an if-guard; a regression that changes the guarded condition silently stops being tested.

nodes.name: CLI command suites
nodes.role: CliRunner-driven behavior tests for dr claim-draft/claim-refresh/claim-promote/publish/review-queue/stats plus a subprocess help smoke test. Good file-state assertions (bytes-before/after), but coverage is uneven: several registered commands are never invoked.
nodes.community_check: agree: graphify communities 16 'Bulk Claim Publisher', 29 'Review Queue Tests', 7 'Claim Statistics Reporter' map one-to-one onto the per-command suites inside this component

nodes.name: Researcher and search-backend suites
nodes.role: Tests the decomposed planner/scorer flow, backend dispatch (brave/tavily/arxiv), URL dedup/canonicalization, blocklist, throttling, and ingestor tools. The respx-mocked HTTP tests are the strongest in the repo; the planner 'corpus' tests are the weakest.
nodes.community_check: agree: graphify communities 2 'Decomposed Research Planner', 6 'Canonical URL Dedup', 11 'Source URL Deduplication', 15 'Tavily Search Backend' are exactly the internal seams of this component

nodes.name: Agent, model, and prompt contract suites
nodes.role: Pydantic model validation (seo_title/takeaway truncation guards, narrative normalization), prompt-builder string contracts, verdict comparison, template loading/rendering. Mostly fast, deterministic, well-targeted unit tests.
nodes.community_check: agree: graphify communities 1 'Claim Template Engine', 3 'Analyst Prompt Builder', 12 'Entity Resolution Parser', 17 'Verdict Comparison Logic', 21 'Source Type Classification' partition this component along its natural seams

nodes.name: Infra suites and drift guards
nodes.role: Logging handler wiring, frontmatter round-trips, linter check functions, and a source-scanning meta-test that greps production code for undocumented StepError.error_type literals. The vocab scanner is a genuinely useful drift guard, at the cost of four bespoke regexes.
nodes.community_check: agree: graphify community 4 'Logging Setup' matches test_logging_setup; the drift-guard scanner is invisible to the import graph (it reads files, it does not import them), so the graph under-reports its coupling to all of pipeline/

nodes.name: Live acceptance tests
nodes.role: Marker-gated (-m acceptance) live-LLM tests: scorer split, planner structure, analyst false-verdict, one full-pipeline smoke. Correctly skipped by default, key-gated per provider, model selection mirrors CLI env vars. The gating design is sound.
nodes.community_check: disagree: no graphify community surfaces the acceptance layer as distinct; its members were folded into the planner/scorer communities even though its execution model (live APIs, opt-in marker) is categorically different

nodes.name: llm-tester provider harness
nodes.role: Standalone T1-T5 capability prober for Infomaniak/GreenPT OpenAI-compatible endpoints, built during the multi-provider evaluation (now complete). Zero imports from or into the pipeline; results matrix is hand-maintained in two places.
nodes.community_check: agree: graphify community 8 'GreenPT LLM Harness' captures this as an isolated island, matching its fan_in=0/fan_out=0 metrics
